messages:
Nina (product): Quick sync: big enterprise asks keep coming in for granular cost breakdowns per dashboard + deterministic trace links from errors. We need to decide scope for next quarter.
Ravi (eng): Two separate problems: (1) cost attribution UI & metrics (token/trace cost per-customer/per-route) and (2) deterministic trace discoverability (error -> canonical trace id even when sampling). Both have infra implications.
Tess (sre): Observability ops: cost attribution needs consistent request IDs propagated across services and retention alignment with billing windows. For trace discoverability, we can store a lightweight trace pointer for every error (span id + segment pointers) without storing full trace. That pointer lets us reconstruct later.
Abe (acct): Customers want line-item view they can export (CSV) and map to invoices. Also some customers insist on per-request trace exports for audits. That suggests two tiers: summary cost UI + on-demand full-export for opted-in customers.
Kai (design): UI idea: add a "Cost breakdown" tab on customer workspace showing top N routes, avg cost/req, 95th latency, and a downloadable CSV. Error cards should show "trace pointer" with badge if full trace available and a CTA to "Request full trace". Keep UI lightweight.
Nina (product): Proposed prioritization: 1) Deliver cost breakdown MVP (top 20 routes, exportable) 2) Implement lightweight trace pointers for errors 3) On-demand reconstruction/export for enterprise opt-in. Launch criteria: cost tab in beta, export works, trace pointer show in error card.
Ravi (eng): Rough effort: cost tab + export ~1.5 sprints (data pipeline + UI). Trace pointer + pointer index ~1 sprint. Reconstruction/export spike ~2 sprints to validate performance and cost. Need to consider backfill for existing data.
Tess (sre): Constraints: retention parity: pointers need to live at least as long as billing cycle (30d) or as customer-specified. Also add quotas for export jobs and a job-queue with throttling. Ops must be able to revoke exports.
Abe (acct): Can we gate full-export behind contract addendum? We need legal + security sign-off for giving full traces. For most deals, customers will accept opt-in paid feature.
Nina (product): Risks & mitigations: increased storage/IO for reconstruction (mitigate via on-demand caching + eviction), potential PII in traces (require redaction & export audit), and UX confusion if pointer exists but reconstruction fails (use clear error state + retry).
Ravi (eng): Action items: I'll open RFC with data model for cost rows, schema for "trace pointer" (id, offsets, ingest segment refs), and API for export. Propose a canary with 1 enterprise (Abe will coordinate) on Dedicated to measure export latency/cost.
Kai (design): I'll prototype cost tab and error-card pointer treatment; will show incremental loading pattern for reconstructed traces.
Tess (sre): I'll draft ops runbook: export queue, rate limits, alert thresholds, SLO for export completion (< 60s for 90% of requests in canary), and auditing requirements.
Abe (acct): I'll check with AcmeCorp legal about contract language and come back. If we charge for export, we can cover infra cost.
scheduler-bot: Reminder: RFC review meeting scheduled for 1711370000.
Nina (product): Thanks team. We need a final decision by next planning sync. Marking as priority: cost-tab MVP + trace pointer index for Q2.
